_note: Corridors run along the borders between cells (see src/sim/edges.ts). Costs are per 10 m of corridor; short arc pieces cost in proportion. The finish is purely a look for now. Removing a corridor costs the same as drawing it in its finish: the walls of the rooms around it have to be rebuilt. Along the shaft wall (circle 0) a corridor is always a gallery tube: a glass-walled, pressurized walkway hanging on the shaft side, in its own finish and cost.
